name: WF-257 — Seller Response → Offer/Counteroffer Classification & Negotiation Routing

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const response=String(d.seller_response??d.message??"").trim();const response_status=String(d.response_status??"response_received").toLowerCase();const n=(response.match(/(?:\\$|USD\\s*)?([0-9]{1,3}(?:,[0-9]{3})*(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)/)||[])[1];const counteroffer=n?Number(n.replace(/,/g,"")):null;const text=response.toLowerCase();let classification="other_response",next="WF-258",reason="Seller response requires negotiation routing.",review=true;if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){classification="blocked";next="WF-126";reason="Missing lead, deal, or property identity.";}else if(response_status!=="response_received"){classification=response_status==="no_response"?"no_response":"unconfirmed_response";next="WF-258";reason="Seller response is not confirmed as received.";}else if(/\\b(yes|accept|accepted|deal|agreed|agree|sounds good|let's do it)\\b/.test(text)&&!counteroffer){classification="accepted";next="WF-258";reason="Seller appears to have accepted the offer.";review=true;}else if(/\\b(no|reject|rejected|decline|declined|not interested|pass)\\b/.test(text)){classification="rejected";next="WF-259";reason="Seller rejected the offer.";review=true;}else if(counteroffer!==null){classification="counteroffer";next="WF-259";reason="Seller response contains a numeric counteroffer.";review=true;}else if(/\\b(how|why|when|what|can you|could you|explain|question)\\b/.test(text)){classification="question";next="WF-258";reason="Seller response appears to be a question or clarification request.";review=true;}else{classification="other_response";next="WF-258";reason="Seller response received but needs interpretation.";review=true;}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-257",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,response_status,seller_response:response,response_classification:classification,counteroffer_amount:counteroffer,reason,requires_human_review:review,next_workflow:next,negotiation_route:classification==="counteroffer"?"counteroffer":classification==="accepted"?"acceptance":classification==="rejected"?"rejection":"follow_up"}}];
